lines: Abhi dhoondh hi rahi thi tumhein yeh nazar hamari
couplets.en: My eyes were still looking for you.

lines: Ke tum aa gaye achanak, badi umr hai tumhari
couplets.en: And there you were all at once, as if called.

lines: Abhi dhoondh hi rahi thi tumhein yeh nazar hamari
couplets.en: My eyes were still looking for you.

lines: Abhi kuchh hi der pehle bada zikr tha tumhara
couplets.en: Only moments ago, your name was on our lips.

lines: Kai baar dhadkanon ne tumhein pyaar se pukara
couplets.en: Again and again my heart called tenderly to you.

lines: Mita intezaar dil ka, hui khatm beqarari
couplets.en: The heart is done waiting and can rest at last.

lines: Badi umr hai tumhari
couplets.en: May you live long.

lines: Abhi dhoondh hi rahi thi tumhein yeh nazar hamari
couplets.en: My eyes were still looking for you.

lines: Hamein pyaar ki khushi se kiya aashna tumhin ne
couplets.en: You were the one who showed me the joy of love.

lines: Tumhein pyaar hum woh denge jo diya na ho kisi ne
couplets.en: I will love you as no one ever has.

lines: Ke tumhari zindagi hai hamein jaan se bhi pyaari
couplets.en: Your life is dearer to me than my own.

lines: Badi umr hai tumhari
couplets.en: May you live long.

lines: Abhi dhoondh hi rahi thi tumhein yeh nazar hamari
couplets.en: My eyes were still looking for you.

lines: Woh nazar ke saamne hai jise humne deen sadaein
couplets.en: The one I called to is here before my eyes.

lines: Jo qarar ban ke aaya, use kyun na dein duaein
couplets.en: How could I withhold a blessing from the one who brought me peace?

lines: Kiye aarzu ne sajde, dil ne nazar utaari
couplets.en: Longing bowed in prayer, and the heart warded off the evil eye.

lines: Badi umr hai tumhari
couplets.en: May you live long.
